Calculate [MATH: \displaystyle \int 8\cosh t \, extrm{d}t.]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
Recall that

[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} \dfrac{ extrm d}{ extrm d t}(\sinh t) = \cosh{t} \quad\Rightarrow\quad \int \cosh{t} \, extrm dt = \sinh{t} + C.]

Therefore, we have

[MATH: ∫8\cosh tdt = 8∫\cosh tdt = 8\sinh t + C.]

sections.normalized_html:
[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits}]

Recall that

[MATH: \dfrac{ extrm d}{ extrm d x}(\sech x) = -\sech{x} anh x \quad\Rightarrow\quad \int \sech{x} anh{x} \, extrm dx = -\sech{x} + C.]

Therefore, we have

[MATH: ∫(− 3sech x anh x)dx|= − 3∫sech x anh xdx; = − 3(− sech x) + C; = 3sech x + C.]
